name: registered-id-excluded-critical-constraint
description: registeredID name constraints have no RFC 5280-defined syntax or semantics. Mirrored from registered-id-critical-constraint with excludedSubtrees: a validator that recognizes the registeredID form should reject the chain (leaf SAN matches the excluded entry), while a validator that refuses to evaluate an unknown name form under a critical constraint should fail closed. Validators that silently accept (defaulting unknown-form excludes to 'not excluded') would diverge from validators that reject for either reason.
notes: Intentionally outside the fully specified name forms. The asymmetry between permitted and excluded matters: a validator that treats an unsupported permitted form as 'no matching permit, reject' may treat an unsupported excluded form as 'no matching exclude, accept', producing a security-relevant divergence.
